map.BMR 是完全静息（躺着不动）的最低消耗；TDEE = BMR × 活动系数（1: BMR is the minimum burn at complete rest (lying still); TDEE = BMR x activity factor (1.2 sedentary to 1.9 heavy labour). Cutting fat needs a TDEE − 300~500 kcal deficit, gaining muscle needs a +300~500 surplus, and never diet below BMR for long periods or the metabolism can be damaged.
